title: Manchester
summary: What is hiding in a city’s name? Follow the ending back in time.
question: What does the -chester part of Manchester mean?
completion: Ending explained! Manchester’s -chester follows Old English ceaster, borrowed from Latin castra, a military camp. The beginning preserves an older local name. We explained the ending, not every part of the name.
partner: A city can stay in one place while its name changes through time.
